newsitem.title: USA: Ross Stores July sales beat expectations.
newsitem.headline: Ross Stores July sales beat expectations.

text.p: Ross Stores Inc said sales for the month of July were stronger than expected, benefiting from its agressive approach to clearing out as much end of season spring product as possible.
As a result, in-store inventory levels in the approach to the fall season are even with last year on a same store basis.

Ross said results for the second quarter will be reported on Tuesday, August 19, 1997, with earnings per share estimated to reach record levels of $0.54 or $0.55 for the 13 weeks ending August 2, 1997, up 50 percent or more over the $0.36 in earnings per share for the 13 weeks ended August 3, 1996.
